$comment: Stage spec: external_attack_surface — DEFINE the attack surface (liveness + port scan + service fingerprint + HTTP probe + screenshots). 阶段重排 2026-06-09: 端口/服务前移到此 (先定义 host×端口×服务×活web); JS/API 移交 enumeration. 见 docs/design/2026-06-09-active-stage-verify-first.md.
$comment_findings_allowed: Attack-surface mapping stage: the deliverable is liveness/port/service coverage, NOT vulnerabilities. submit_stage_deliverable drops any findings submitted here and tells the model to put discoveries in claims. Design 2026-06-15-recon-stage-findings-suppression.
$comment_host_aware: Host-aware coverage 2b (design 2026-06-15-host-aware-coverage §3.2): EAS is host-level — a bare URL endpoint drops GOLISH-EAS-PORT/SERVICE-FINGERPRINT (its host is already covered via the host/IP asset) but keeps LIVENESS; domain/IP/CIDR keep all 3; unknown class keeps all 3 (fail-safe). The per-asset technique_applies matrix landed inert (commit e12a7638); this flips the stage flag on so coverage_complete filters each in-scope asset to the techniques that apply to its class (via technique_applies_to_value). Default false = byte-for-byte unchanged.
$comment_freshness_window: Phase E activation (design 2026-06-22 Phase D): gray-switch ON. The EAS DB-truth back-fill (GOLISH-EAS-LIVENESS/PORT/SERVICE-FINGERPRINT) only counts data collected this stage-run (targets.liveness_checked_at/ports_scanned_at + fingerprints.detected_at >= stage start; migration 20260623000001). EAS coverage_complete now uses authoritative DB/ledger found facts, so self-reported found cells cannot fake active surface coverage. Default false = presence-only.

hints: add evidence to each claim via prior tool calls
add evidence to each finding via prior tool calls

on_fail.reason: every found EAS coverage cell must cite evidence
hints: cite the evidence id from the tool run that produced this liveness / port / service fact

on_fail.reason: every checked_empty EAS coverage cell must cite evidence
hints: cite the scan/probe evidence proving the technique ran and returned no applicable result

gate_rules.$comment_derive: 2026-06-25 EAS slim closeout: DB business-table truth补格 — GOLISH-EAS-LIVENESS←targets(http_status/real_ip), -PORT←targets.ports, -SERVICE-FINGERPRINT←fingerprints, plus technique_outcomes provenance where available. 真跑工具落库后 coverage 格自动补 found; authoritative_found means a hand-written found cell no longer counts without DB/ledger truth. Negative/blocked terminal cells still need explicit checked_empty+evidence or blocked/not_applicable+note until active Empty facts are complete.

on_fail.reason: external attack surface incomplete: some in-scope assets were not fully mapped (liveness / port / service-fingerprint)
hints: for EVERY in-scope asset, take each applicable EAS technique to a terminal coverage cell: found+evidence_refs / checked_empty+evidence_refs / blocked|not_applicable+note. IP/domain/CIDR assets require PORT; bare URL assets keep only LIVENESS because host-level PORT/SERVICE belongs to the host/IP target

intel-source data (FOFA/Shodan/...) is a lead, not proof — actively confirm each asset NOW; the gate auto-projects found cells from DB truth (httpx→targets, naabu/masscan→targets.ports, whatweb/nmap→fingerprints) so running the real tools fills coverage; JS/API extraction happens in the NEXT stage (enumeration)

gate_rules.$comment_authoritative: EAS found coverage is now adjudicated from DB/ledger truth (targets.ports + fingerprints + technique_outcomes), so denominator fields should not be hand-copied into the deliverable. coverage_complete owns completeness; denominator remains as a documented no-op for this slim DB-truth stage.

hints: for service fingerprint coverage set tested_units to the number of discovered open ports fingerprinted and total_units to the number of discovered open ports
if a host has no open ports, mark SERVICE-FINGERPRINT not_applicable with a note instead of checked_empty total_units=0
do not treat HTTP liveness alone as PORT or SERVICE-FINGERPRINT coverage

$comment_expected_techniques: EAS = 定义攻击面（阶段重排 2026-06-09：端口/服务前移到此）。coverage_complete 对权威 in_scope_assets 逐资产核 LIVENESS+PORT+SERVICE-FINGERPRINT 终态；漏一个 = not_attempted = Block。JS/API 已移交 enumeration。
$comment_stage_run: stage_run fan-out (design 2026-06-13-stage-run-fanout §3.2): specialist = the per-org sub-agent the stage_run tool fans out (EAS → prober, the ACTIVE surface-mapper split from Pentester, mirroring recon for target_intel); coverage_axis = the human-readable technique columns StageRunView renders per org row (one per expected technique: liveness / port / service-fingerprint).
$comment_min_invocations: 2026-06-25 EAS slim DB-truth closeout: no hard tool floor in the deliverable. Active work is proven by coverage_complete reading DB/ledger facts (targets liveness/ports, fingerprints, technique_outcomes). A required_checks_done/http_probe floor only reintroduces model hand-copying and blocks otherwise valid DB-truth runs.
$comment_facts_from_db_truth: 2026-06-25: EAS now matches target_intel's slim deliverable pattern for found cells. The worker runs active tools and lets DB/ledger truth fill found LIVENESS/PORT/SERVICE-FINGERPRINT cells; submit only negative/blocked terminal cells the DB cannot derive.
